description: Defines the FloatingRate entity class with properties, creation, update, and interest rate fetching logic for the Fineract project.

classes.name: FloatingRate
classes.description: Entity class representing a floating interest rate with associated periods, creation, update, and interest rate retrieval logic.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Creates a new FloatingRate instance from a JsonCommand input.

methods.name: getRatePeriods
methods.description: Extracts a list of FloatingRatePeriod objects from a JsonCommand.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the floating rate.

methods.name: isBaseLendingRate
methods.description: Indicates if the rate is a base lending rate.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Indicates if the rate is active.

methods.name: getFloatingRatePeriods
methods.description: Returns the list of associated floating rate periods.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the FloatingRate properties based on a JsonCommand.

methods.name: updateRatePeriods
methods.description: Updates the list of rate periods, deactivating future ones.

methods.name: fetchInterestRates
methods.description: Retrieves applicable interest rate data based on a FloatingRateDTO.
